proposal_parameters.scaler: StandardScaler fit on clean training images only; raw for baseline, blurred for blur arms

primary_metric: mean accuracy across 9 conditions per seed, averaged over seeds
pass_rule: Pilot benefit if combined arm beats baseline mean by at least 0.02 and clean accuracy mean is no more than 0.02 below baseline; blur causal mechanism judged separately: falsified if augmentation_only matches or exceeds blur_only on noise_0.6 mean. Exploratory, no significance claim.
hyperparameter_selection: No tuning; proposal values fixed before validation.
first_run_note: An initial held-out execution used a scaler fit after augmentation and is invalid; its artifact is retained as results_invalid_v1.json, not used for conclusions. Corrected protocol executed independently after this preregistration.

prior_art.citation: Rusak et al. 2020, A simple way to make neural networks robust against diverse image corruptions
prior_art.relevance: Noise augmentation is established for corruption robustness.

prior_art.citation: Saikia et al. ICCV 2021, Improving Robustness Against Common Corruptions With Frequency Biased Models
prior_art.relevance: Blur/noise augmentation has frequency-specific robustness effects and clean accuracy tradeoffs.

prior_art.citation: Lopes et al. 2021, On Interaction Between Augmentations and Corruptions in Natural Corruption Robustness
prior_art.relevance: Robustness depends on similarity between training augmentations and test corruptions.
